summary: Iteration 10 (rent category, income no-paid-toggle, delete/edit recurring choice modals, PUT /api/recurring/{rid} cascade) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass in test_recurring_update.py + test_categories.py (updated to 16 categories including 'rent'). Full regression suite: 130/134 pass; the 4 failing tests are pre-existing and unrelated to this iteration (calendar projection ordering, datepicker end-date active flag, unique-index test needs MONGO_URL env). Frontend: (a) Rent category chip is visible and selectable on Add/Edit transaction. (b) Income rows never render tx-paid-toggle — they render a static green down-arrow indicator; expense rows still render the paid checkbox. (c) 'Unpaid' filter hides income (0 income amount elements shown); 'Paid' filter shows income (19). (d) Trash on a recurring row opens a choice modal titled 'Delete recurring transaction?' with choice-dialog-one / choice-dialog-series / choice-dialog-cancel — 'Just this one' deletes exactly one row (4->3); 'Delete entire series' calls DELETE /recurring/{rid}?delete_generated=true and removes rule + all rows (rule_exists=false, rows_left=0). (e) Pencil on a recurring row opens a choice modal titled 'Edit recurring transaction?' with choice-dialog-one / choice-dialog-all — 'Update entire series' navigates to /add-transaction?...&scope=all, header shows 'Edit series', green banner (testID editing-series-banner) reads 'Editing the entire recurring series — changes apply to every transaction in this series.', DatePicker is hidden, and saving cascades: PUT /api/recurring/{rid} then all 4 previously-materialized rows have amount=199.99, category='rent', description='UI_EDIT_ALL2_UPDATED'. (f) Non-recurring pencil navigates directly (scope=one), header 'Edit transaction', Date field visible. (g) Non-recurring trash opens simple confirm dialog (confirm-dialog-confirm), not choice. No LogBox red overlay observed in any flow.

react_native_issues.issue: Console continues to emit '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings. Not blocking; unchanged since iteration 9. Reference: react-native-web deprecation notices.

action_items: No functional action required — all 4 requested changes (rent category, income no-paid-toggle, delete-recurring choice modal, edit-recurring choice modal with cascade) are working end-to-end.

Pre-existing calendar projection tests (test_calendar.py::test_calendar_projects_future_recurring, test_calendar_totals_include_projected) fail when run after other tests that clean up data — main agent may want to make them self-seeding in a future iteration.
Pre-existing test_datepicker_enddate.py::test_create_recurring_with_end_date fails because rule.active is False when end_date is in the past; unrelated to iteration 10.

Pre-existing test_race_condition_recurring.py::test_direct_duplicate_insert_rejected fails because it reads MONGO_URL from os.environ directly (not loaded from backend/.env) — trivial to fix by mirroring the frontend .env loading pattern.
Optional cleanup: address 'shadow*' style prop and 'props.pointerEvents' React-Native-Web deprecation warnings (unchanged since iteration 9).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/recurring/{rid} correctly builds `update` dict from non-None fields, validates 400 on empty body, casts amount to float, and cascades via update_many({user_id, recurring_rule_id: rid}, {$set: update}). Server-side implementation is clean.
RecurringUpdateBody uses Literal['income','expense'] for type so wrong values return 422 via Pydantic — good.

ConfirmDialog useChoice() shares state with useConfirm() via a single Modal — no risk of two overlapping dialogs. Cancel handler correctly resolves boolResolver/choiceResolver depending on which was open.
Dashboard onDelete/goEdit correctly branch on `t.recurring_rule_id` to choose between confirm vs choice modal — non-recurring flow untouched.

Cascade on PUT applies $set of only the fields sent, so previously-materialized rows keep their per-row `date` and `paid` state (verified: 4 rows updated but individual dates preserved). This is the correct semantic for 'edit entire series'.

One nit: RecurringUpdateBody does not accept `frequency`, `start_date`, or `end_date` — if a user wants to change the schedule of an existing series this API cannot do it. This is not part of the current review request; flagging as future enhancement only.
